tasks.label: godot: install Windows build dependencies
tasks.command: pixi run -e build python ${input:checkout}/misc/scripts/install_accesskit.py; pixi run -e build python ${input:checkout}/misc/scripts/install_d3d12_sdk_windows.py

tasks.label: godot: build win64 (cross)
tasks.command: pixi run -e build scons -C ${input:checkout} CXX=${workspaceFolder}/.pixi/envs/build/bin/clang++ use_llvm=yes use_mingw=yes arch=x86_64 precision=${input:precision} target=${input:target} cache_path=/Users/ernest.lee/.cache/scons_cache -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)

windows.command: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && pixi run -e build scons -C ${input:checkout} target=${input:target} windows_subsystem=console -j%NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS%

osx.command: pixi run -e build scons -C ${input:checkout} target=${input:target} -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)
